description: Bornes WIFI 43 du Département de la Haute-Loire is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DNUM - Service études et applications (Département de la Haute-Loire). Location of public WIFI 43 terminals in the Haute-Loire department. Management with the company YZIACT / WIFI CIGALE. Coverage: DNUM - Service études et applications (Département de la Haute-Loire). The portal shows the English title as "Terminals WIFI 43 of the Department of Haute-Loire" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DNUM - Service études et applications (Département de la Haute-Loire). Its keywords include haute-loire. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
